name: DR Congo
summary: An active lava lake you can camp beside on Nyiragongo, the only mountain gorillas outside Rwanda and Uganda, the okapi that lives nowhere else, and five World Heritage sites — a country of superlatives and of serious constraints on reaching them.
when: The dry seasons. Take current advice extremely seriously; the east is not uniformly accessible.

entries.caption: Nyiragongo
entries.description: The world's largest lava lake, in a crater you climb to in a day and sleep beside.
entries.subject: the glowing lava lake in the crater of Nyiragongo at night

entries.caption: The Albertine Rift
entries.description: Glaciers on the Rwenzori, volcanoes in the Virungas, and the deepest forest in Africa between them.
entries.subject: the glaciated peaks of the Rwenzori above forest

entries.caption: Mountain Gorillas and Okapi
entries.description: Virunga's gorillas in the east, and the okapi in the Ituri forest, which lives nowhere else.
entries.subject: an okapi in dense Ituri forest undergrowth

entries.caption: Garamba and Upemba
entries.description: Northern savanna with elephant and Kordofan giraffe, being brought back after decades of loss.
entries.subject: elephants on open savanna in Garamba National Park

entries.caption: The Rwenzori
entries.description: 5,109 metres at Margherita, glaciated, on the equator, and the Mountains of the Moon.
entries.subject: glaciers and rock on the summit ridge of the Rwenzori

entries.caption: Boyoma and Lofoi
entries.description: The seven cataracts at Kisangani, and Lofoi with a single drop of 340 metres.
entries.subject: the Wagenia fishing structures at the Boyoma falls, Kisangani

entries.caption: The Congo River
entries.description: Four and a half thousand kilometres, and the deepest river in the world at 220 metres.
entries.subject: the immense width of the Congo river seen from the bank

entries.caption: Muanda, and the Lakes
entries.description: Forty kilometres of Atlantic at the river mouth, and beaches on Kivu and Tanganyika.
entries.subject: the shore and clear water of Lake Kivu at Goma

entries.caption: The Ituri and the Salonga
entries.description: Salonga is the largest tropical rainforest reserve in Africa, and mostly unentered.
entries.subject: the closed canopy of the Salonga rainforest

entries.caption: Nyiragongo Overnight
entries.description: Six hours up, a night in a hut on the rim, and the lava lake below you all of it.
entries.subject: climbers on the crater rim of Nyiragongo above the lava lake

entries.caption: Two Hundred and Fifty Peoples
entries.description: Four national languages, and a music that has set the terms for the whole continent.
entries.subject: a street market crowd in Kinshasa

entries.caption: The Mbuti
entries.description: Forest hunter-gatherers of the Ituri, with a relationship to that forest going back millennia.
entries.subject: Mbuti hunters with nets in the Ituri forest

entries.caption: Fufu, Pondu and Liboke
entries.description: Cassava fufu, pondu cassava leaf, and fish steamed in leaves over a fire.
entries.subject: fish steamed in banana leaf served with fufu

entries.caption: Rumba and Ndombolo
entries.description: Franco, Papa Wemba, Koffi Olomide — Kinshasa has exported dance music for seventy years.
entries.subject: a rumba band on stage in a Kinshasa nightclub

entries.caption: Masks, Raffia and Copper
entries.description: Kuba raffia cloth, Pende and Songye masks, and Katangese copper crosses.
entries.subject: a length of Kuba raffia cloth with geometric appliqué

entries.caption: Kisangani and the River Stations
entries.description: Stanley's route up the river, and the Wagenia fishing structures that predate all of it.
entries.subject: the wooden Wagenia fishing tripods over rapids at Kisangani

entries.caption: Five World Heritage Sites
entries.description: Virunga, Garamba, Kahuzi-Biega, Salonga and the Okapi Reserve — all five on the danger list.
entries.subject: the forested slopes of Kahuzi-Biega National Park

entries.caption: Kinshasa and Lubumbashi
entries.description: One of the largest cities in Africa, facing Brazzaville, and the mining capital in the south.
entries.subject: the skyline and traffic of Kinshasa on the Congo river

entries.caption: Belgian Colonial and Cite
entries.description: Art deco Kinshasa from the 1930s, and the cite quarters that grew around it.
entries.subject: a 1930s art deco building in central Kinshasa

entries.caption: SAPE
entries.description: The Society of Ambianceurs and Elegant People — dressing as a discipline and an argument.
entries.subject: a sapeur in a bright tailored suit on a Kinshasa street

entries.caption: Not for Families
entries.description: The east requires current advice and the distances are enormous. This is careful travel.
entries.subject: a school class in a village in eastern DR Congo

entries.caption: Volcano and Gorilla
entries.description: Nyiragongo, then gorillas in Virunga's lowlands, from the same base at Goma.
entries.subject: trekkers on a forested slope in Virunga National Park

entries.caption: Virunga's Lodges
entries.description: Mikeno and Tchegera, run by the park itself, and the money goes back into it.
entries.subject: a lodge terrace looking towards the Virunga volcanoes

entries.caption: Virunga's Rangers
entries.description: Over two hundred rangers have died protecting this park. It is the oldest in Africa.
entries.subject: Virunga rangers on patrol at the forest edge

entries.caption: Lava at Night
entries.description: The Nyiragongo crater after dark, when the lake is the only light there is.
entries.subject: the orange glow of Nyiragongo's lava lake at night

entries.caption: Lake Kivu
entries.description: Volcanic islands, terraced hills and calm water, between Goma and Bukavu.
entries.subject: Idjwi island and calm water on Lake Kivu

entries.caption: Why DR Congo
entries.description: A lava lake, mountain gorillas, glaciers on the equator, and the okapi.
entries.subject: a climber silhouetted on the rim above Nyiragongo's lava lake
